news.title: Introducing Gemini 3.5 Flash Cyber

news.summary: Google DeepMind has released Gemini 3.5 Flash Cyber, a lightweight cybersecurity model to find and patch vulnerabilities. This model can be used to scan and protect enterprise network infrastructure.
news.enterprise_use: This new AI model can be used to automate vulnerability scanning and patching, freeing up IT teams to focus on other tasks. If not integrated, this could leave enterprises vulnerable to known exploits. Most IT teams will find this useful when combined with existing endpoint security and MDM platforms, specifically tools like CrowdStrike and Cloudflare.

news.title: VentureBeat Research: Where enterprise AI agent governance hasn't caught up
news.summary_raw: Enterprises deployed AI agents ahead of the controls needed to manage them — and they did it knowingly. That is the central finding across the five parallel surveys VentureBeat Research fielded in June, spanning every layer of the agentic stack. news.summary: VentureBeat Research found enterprises deployed AI agents before implementing governance controls, with 57-68% planning to switch or add vendors within 12 months.
news.enterprise_use: Note that AI agent governance control is a pressing concern, and IT teams may need to budget and plan for future control infrastructure upgrades. Monitor existing AI vendor contracts for potential switch-out clauses. Consider investing in vendor-agnostic AI governance tools.
